description: Shelly integration (GIGA/Opta 4.1+): every registered Shelly with IP, model, online state, relay state, and its bindings (which myIO output a channel follows, which myIO button an input drives, which universal sensor a metric feeds). scan=true also shows the results of a network scan (start one with myio_shelly_set action=scan). Editor/admin level.
